newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil flat for now but Russian exports loom.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil flat for now but Russian exports loom.

text.p: NWE gas oil was little changed on Wednesday but some dealers expected downward pressure on premiums for physical oil.
Barges were pegged around 75 cents above the IPE June contract for loading at Flushing or Antwerp but $2.50 over for Rotterdam barrels.
"You might even get $2 in Rotterdam if you haggle," said German based trader. June IPE was down 25 cents at $177.50 at 1111 GMT.
Cargoes were quiet but growing Russian exports may pressure premiums in the next few days.
Cargoes were offered from Ventspils at $7 a tonne below quotations and may slip toward $8 under in the next few days, traders said.
In the Mediterranean Odessa exported good volumes with talk high quotes flat after trade earlier this week at $1 above.
Russian exports doubled last week to 461,000 bpd from 231,000 the previous week, said consultants Petro-Logistics.
This is 115,000 bpd above same week a year earlier.
Talk for EN590 held close to Tuesday levels around $9.75 a tonne over the IPE cif Rotterdam or $7.50 to $8 over heating oil on barges.
